clues.text: Instead of obeying God's call, this prophet paid the fare for a ship bound for Tarshish to flee the LORD.
During a raging storm at sea, sailors threw this man overboard, and the waters grew calm.
This prophet from Gath-hepher foretold that King Jeroboam would restore Israel's border from Lebo-hamath to the Sea of the Arabah.
Walking into the great city of Nineveh, he proclaimed that in forty more days it would be overturned.
When God spared a repentant city, this prophet grew angry, saying he knew God was gracious and compassionate.
Sitting east of a city, he enjoyed a vine's shade until God sent a worm to wither it.
Jesus told scribes and Pharisees that no sign would be given them except the sign of this prophet.
